name: manual_629892
claim: Oramasys C6 agent smoke of 6 sends is not host qualification. Mac controls and three 2400-send passes on CPython 3.13.15 with SQLite 3.53.1 met the latency budgets and had zero final errors, with two fail-closed lookup errors on the second candidate. That interpreter is not the selected 3.13.18 baseline, the zero-error upper bound is about 0.125 percent, and Windows tiers were not run. Serving stays unset. R6 needs a different reviewer, and R7 and R8 stay open.

decisions.notes: The board keeps R7 and R8 open. The earlier wording said closed, which reads as if those gates had passed. Serving stays unset.
